basis: Type I MADS factor expressed only in the syncytial endosperm and needed to suppress cellularization (Kang et al. 2008 Plant Cell); Martin 2026 3 DAP 'PEN general' cluster named for it. Not DE in Picard 2021 at 4 DAP (falls at cellularization), so not raised: use only for syncytial stages. characterized_markers.tsv (promoter-GFP syncytial endosperm-specific) rests on the same Kang 2008 paper, so not raised.

FIS-PRC2 subunit; maternal FIS2-GUS in central cell and coenocytic endosperm nuclei, switched off before cellularization except in the chalazal cyst (Luo et al. 2000 PNAS). Picard 2021: up in S-phase clusters (CxV E2/E11, VxC E8) and CxV E14. Stage-restricted.

R2R3-MYB expressed in the endosperm that represses endosperm maturation (Barthole et al. 2014 Plant Cell). Up in ~9 Picard 2021 endosperm clusters (highest VxC E4 micropylar); LCM MCE-enriched (Belmonte 2013). Pan-endosperm, strongest at maturation.

Endosperm-specific bHLH expressed in the embryo-surrounding region; needed for endosperm breakdown and embryo cuticle (Yang et al. 2008 Development; Kondou et al. 2008 Plant Physiol). ESR cluster marker in Picard 2021 (CxV E9 ES 5.5, VxC E4 4.4) and Martin 2026 (7 DAP MCE_ESR general).

Subtilase expressed only in the endosperm (ESR), ZOU-dependent, needed for embryo cuticle (Xing et al. 2013 Development). Top ESR gene in two independent snRNA datasets: Picard 2021 (VxC E4 ES 12.3, CxV E9 10.6) and Martin 2026 (5 DAP MCE, 7 DAP MCE_ESR). Also RNA in situ in endosperm cells around the embryo (Tanaka et al. 2001 Development; via characterized_markers.tsv); already high.

KERBEROS peptide, ZOU-dependent, needed for embryo sheath formation and embryo-endosperm separation (Moussu et al. 2017 Plant Cell). Martin 2026 7 DAP ESR cluster named for it; not DE in Picard 2021 at 4 DAP (sheath forms later), so not raised.

bHLH partner of ZOU, co-expressed in endosperm and needed for endosperm breakdown (Denay et al. 2014 Development). Enriched in Picard 2021 ESR clusters (VxC E4 4.5, CxV E9 3.1) but also in seed coat CxV S6 and stomatal lineage: not ESR-specific on its own.

UDP-arabinopyranose mutase; ESR gene in Fourquin et al. 2016 Development (as cited by Martin 2026). Top ESR marker in Picard 2021 (CxV E9 ES 8.8, VxC E4 7.5) and Martin 2026 (5 DAP MCE, 7 DAP ESR sheath-promoting).
GDSL lipase; HCR in the ESR at 7 DAP (Martin 2026); top gene of Picard 2021 CxV E9 (ES 12.6). Not raised: also VxC E6 (chalazal cyst, ES 5.6) in Picard 2021.

Amino acid transporter; in situ in micropylar endosperm plus seed coat and cellularization front (Picard 2021 ED Fig 6b); Martin 2026 5 DAP MCE top marker. Conflict: Rombi 2026 MERFISH puts it in seed coat ii1'; Picard 2021 seed coat S5 ES 6.0. Use only with endosperm identity established.

Auxin response factor; micropylar endosperm expression in the ARF expression map (Rademacher et al. 2011 Plant J, as cited by Martin 2026); Martin 2026 3 DAP MCE cluster; Picard 2021 VxC E3 only (ES 14.9, 4 nuclei); LCM MCE (Belmonte 2013).
Peroxisomal citrate synthase (function unrelated to ESR); Picard 2021 CxV E9 ES 13.1 and Martin 2026 7 DAP ESR clusters (general and high-PCD).
GDSL lipase (uncharacterized); Picard 2021 ESR clusters (VxC E4 ES 11.3, CxV E9 7.1) and Martin 2026 7 DAP ESR general top marker.
Early nodulin-like phytocyanin (uncharacterized in seed); Picard 2021 ESR clusters (VxC E4 ES 8.7, CxV E9 5.6) and Martin 2026 5 DAP MCE top marker.

WRKY TF controlling seed size; promoter-GUS in the developing endosperm until cellularization and in the globular embryo (Luo et al. 2005 PNAS, abstract). Belmonte 2013 PNAS: 'expressed primarily in the MCE' (DP18 W-box set). Picard 2021 only VxC E3 (ES 10.5, 4-nucleus cluster) and endothelium VxC S8 (4.5), so not raised.

Sucrose transporter; SWEET15-eGFP reaches the endosperm after the outer integument (Chen et al. 2015 Plant Cell). ESR-enriched in Picard 2021 in both crosses (CxV E9 ES 8.7, VxC E4 8.6); micropylar restriction shown by one study only.

Uncharacterized; HCR in the chalazal cyst (Martin 2026 Fig 4c), also a top marker of Martin's 3 DAP nodule cluster; Picard 2021 cyst (VxC E6 ES 7.0, CxV E13 5.2) and nodule VxC E1 2.8. Nodule vs cyst assignment conflicts, so filed as chalazal.

GA 3-oxidase; chalazal endosperm by LCM (Le 2010; Belmonte 2013 CZE); Picard 2021 nodule VxC E1 ES 9.5 and cyst CxV E13 6.7; Martin 2026 3 DAP nodule-like and 7 DAP cyst clusters. Pan-chalazal. Update 2026-10-20 (Belmonte2013 review): Fig 5B shows it CZE-primary, not exclusive; Belmonte was already counted, so not raised again.
Type I MADS (PHERES2); Picard 2021 nodule and cyst (CxV E12 ES 9.4, VxC E1 6.5, CxV E13 4.7) and Martin 2026 3 DAP nodule-like top marker.

FIS-PRC2 SET protein; MEA-GUS like FIS2 persists in the chalazal cyst (Luo et al. 2000 PNAS). Marks a 'nodule-like' chalazal population in both Picard 2021 (CxV E14 ES 14.5, one cross) and Martin 2026 (5 DAP nodule-like), which Martin's pseudotime places between PEN and CZE.

ABA biosynthesis NCED; promoter-GUS/GFP and in situ expression exclusively in the endosperm during seed development, needed for seed ABA (Lefebvre et al. 2006 Plant J, abstract). Belmonte 2013 PNAS LCM CZE-primary (Fig 5B); Picard 2021 nodules (CxV E12 ES 5.8, VxC E1 4.6) and cyst (VxC E6 3.3). Pan-chalazal.

ABA biosynthesis NCED expressed in embryo and endosperm (Lefebvre et al. 2006 Plant J). Belmonte 2013 PNAS LCM CZE-high but also embryo (Fig 5B); not DE in Picard 2021. Not specific: use only with other chalazal markers.

Formin; in situ transcripts at the posterior (chalazal) pole of the endosperm, atfh5 perturbs cellularization and chalazal cyst morphogenesis (Ingouff et al. 2005 Nat Cell Biol; via characterized_markers.tsv). Not DE in Picard 2021 at 4 DAP; one study, so medium.

GA 20-oxidase; RNA in situ only in chalazal nodules, both reciprocal crosses (Picard 2021 Fig 2, ED Fig 6c; ES 13.3/10.8); LCM CZE (Belmonte 2013); Martin 2026 3 DAP top marker, but of the 'nodule-like' cluster. Also Picard seed coat VxC S6 (5.5).

G1/S D-type cyclin; RNA in situ restricted to nodules (Picard 2021 Fig 2; ES 11.9/10.7). Not raised: Martin 2026 named its nodule cluster from Picard's list (not independent). Cell-cycle gene: check against S-phase signal.

HD-ZIP IV factor; nodule top marker in Picard 2021 (CxV E12 ES 11.6, VxC E1 11.0) and Martin 2026 (3 and 5 DAP nodule clusters); LCM CZE. Conflict: also Picard cyst (7.2/6.3), and Martin's curated table lists it as a cyst gene (Nakamura 2006).
Beta-galactosidase (function unrelated to nodule identity); Picard 2021 nodules (VxC E1 ES 11.4, CxV E12 10.8), Martin 2026 3 and 5 DAP nodule top marker, LCM CZE.
Type I MADS (uncharacterized); Picard 2021 nodules (VxC E1 ES 10.3, CxV E12 8.0; also CxV E14), Martin 2026 3 DAP nodule top marker, LCM CZE.
Type I MADS (uncharacterized); Picard 2021 nodules (CxV E12 ES 14.0, VxC E1 4.9) and LCM CZE (Belmonte 2013).
Defensin-like peptide (uncharacterized); Picard 2021 nodules (VxC E1 ES 8.6, CxV E12 6.6; cyst VxC E6 5.2) and Martin 2026 3 and 5 DAP nodule top marker.

Heavy-metal-associated isoprenylated protein; RNA in situ in the cyst only, nodules negative (Picard 2021 Fig 2; ES 14.6/13.5); LCM CZE (Le 2010; Belmonte 2013); Martin 2026 5 DAP apical cyst top marker.
DUF239 NEP-interacting protein (uncharacterized); RNA in situ in the cyst only (Picard 2021 Fig 2; ES 12.7/10.4, some nodule signal 6.5); LCM CZE; Martin 2026 5 DAP apical cyst top marker.
Type I MADS (uncharacterized); most cyst-specific gene in Picard 2021 (CxV E13 ES 17.9, VxC E6 16.5); LCM chalazal endosperm (Le 2010; Belmonte 2013).

Type-B response regulator; promoter activity in chalazal endosperm and chalazal seed coat (Jeong et al. 2025 Plant Direct); Picard 2021 cyst (CxV E13 ES 14.3, VxC E6 10.1); Martin 2026 7 DAP cyst cluster. Not cyst-specific in the reporter (chalazal seed coat too).

RALF-like peptide; HCR in the basal cyst (Martin 2026 Fig 4c); Picard 2021 cyst enrichment is modest (VxC E6 ES 4.9, CxV E13 2.7; also CxV E2). Not raised: Martin assigned its basal-cyst nuclei by hand on RALFL3.
H3K9 methyltransferase-like, paternally expressed imprinted gene; cyst-restricted in Picard 2021 (CxV E13 ES 9.4, VxC E6 8.0) only.

GA 3-oxidase; Belmonte 2013 PNAS LCM CZE-high (Fig 5B; Belmonte marker sheet CZE) and Picard 2021 cyst in both crosses (CxV E13 ES 16.8, VxC E6 11.6; no nodule signal). The LCM merges cyst and nodules, so the cyst call rests on Picard. Symbol trap: UniProt Q9SVS8 lists AtGA3ox4 as an alias; GA3OX4 proper is AT1G80330.

3xHMG-box protein bound to mitotic chromosomes (Pedersen et al. 2011 New Phytol); in situ in dividing nuclei of embryo, micropylar endosperm and cellularization front (Picard 2021 ED Fig 6b); G2/M top marker in Martin 2026 (3 and 5 DAP). Mitotic state, not a domain.

3xHMG-box protein (Pedersen et al. 2011 New Phytol); G2/M clusters in Picard 2021 (CxV E4 ES 11.4, VxC E2 10.0) and Martin 2026 top marker. Symbol trap: UniProt calls this locus HMGB6, while TAIR HMGB6 is AT5G23420.
Plant-specific G2/M cyclin-dependent kinase; Picard 2021 curated M-phase marker (Supp Data 3) and M-phase clusters (CxV E4 ES 11.2, VxC E2 8.5).
DNA topoisomerase II, proliferation marker; Picard 2021 M-phase clusters (VxC E2 ES 11.0, CxV E4 10.4) and Martin 2026 5 DAP G2/M top marker.

Auxin efflux carrier located apically in the basal cell lineage (Friml et al. 2003 Nature, abstract). Belmonte 2013 PNAS LCM: SUS >> EP at globular by ATH1 and qRT-PCR (Fig 4E); Martin 2026 3 DAP suspensor cluster labelled by it. Two independent studies, so medium.

YUCCA flavin monooxygenase (auxin synthesis). Belmonte 2013 PNAS LCM: SUS > EP at globular by ATH1 and qRT-PCR (Fig 4C); Martin 2026 3 DAP suspensor top-15 marker. Raised low to medium for two-study agreement.
Auxin response factor; Belmonte 2013 PNAS LCM: SUS > EP at globular by ATH1 and qRT-PCR (Fig 4D) only.

HD-ZIP IV factor needed for mucilage production in the oi2 epidermis (Windsor et al. 2000 Plant J; Western et al. 2001). oi2 cluster marker in Picard 2021 (S2 ES 5.4/5.6), Martin 2026 and Rombi 2026. Use to flag seed coat contamination.

YABBY TF; in situ restricted to the outer (abaxial) layer of the outer integument, ino lacks outer integument growth (Villanueva et al. 1999 Genes Dev; via characterized_markers.tsv). Ovule-stage evidence (medium) raised for Martin 2026 3 DAP oi2 S-phase top-15. Not DE in Picard 2021.

UDP-rhamnose synthase for oi2 mucilage (Western et al. 2004 Plant Physiol; via characterized_markers.tsv); Martin 2026 7 DAP oi2 general top-15. Lowered for this group: broadly expressed, and in Picard 2021 up in endosperm clusters (CxV E8 ES 3.5, VxC E11 3.4, CxV E11 3.4) and Belmonte LCM GSC.

Sucrose efflux from the seed coat to the embryo; native-promoter SWEET15-eGFP in the outer integument and later the endosperm (Chen et al. 2015 Plant Cell; via characterized_markers.tsv). Conflict: in Picard 2021 it is an ESR gene in both crosses (CxV E9 ES 8.7, VxC E4 8.6), seed coat only 2.3. Use in seed coat nuclei only.

Vacuolar processing enzyme expressed transiently in inner integument layers ii2/ii3 and needed for their cell death (Nakaune et al. 2005 Plant Cell). Picard 2021 S5 (ii1'+ii2; ES 6.5/5.7), LCM GSC, Martin 2026 ii1'/ii2.

KANADI TF patterning the inner integument; in situ in the inner integument of ovules (McAbee et al. 2006 Plant J; via characterized_markers.tsv). Ovule-stage evidence. Conflict: Belmonte LCM marker sheet lists it as embryo proper (EP); not DE in Picard 2021.

Anthocyanidin reductase; promoter active only in proanthocyanidin cells of the endothelium and pigment strand (Debeaujon et al. 2003 Plant Cell). Endothelium marker in Picard 2021 (VxC S7/S8), Martin 2026 and Rombi 2026.

WIP zinc finger needed for endothelium differentiation (Debeaujon 2003; Sagasser 2002); endothelium marker in Martin 2026 and micropylar endothelium in Rombi 2026. Picard 2021: VxC S8 (ES 7.9) but also VxC E3 (14.1), the 4-nucleus 'canonical micropylar endosperm' cluster.
R2R3-MYB that activates BAN for PA synthesis in the endothelium (Debeaujon 2003). Picard 2021 VxC S7/S8 (ES 4.0/3.8) but also oi2 S2 (4.4) and S5; LCM CZSC.

B-sister MADS TF needed for endothelium differentiation and PA accumulation; in situ/reporter in the innermost integument layer (Nesi et al. 2002 Plant Cell; via characterized_markers.tsv). Not DE in Picard 2021 seed coat clusters.

MATE vacuolar flavonoid transporter; promoter-GUS in PA-synthesizing endothelium, tt12 lacks seed-coat PA (Marinova et al. 2007 Plant Cell; via characterized_markers.tsv). Picard 2021 endothelium VxC S7/S8 (ES 5.9/5.7); Martin 2026 ii1 basal top-15 (3/5 DAP).

Amino acid exporter in the chalazal unloading zone for seed loading (Müller et al. 2015 Curr Biol). Picard 2021 chalazal seed coat (CxV S3 ES 8.2, VxC S6 7.1), LCM CZSC, Martin 2026 placentochalazal, Rombi 2026 ULD (MERFISH).
Response regulator; promoter-GUS in the chalaza (Horák et al. 2008 BMC Plant Biol). Picard 2021 chalazal seed coat (CxV S3 ES 6.1, VxC S6 4.7), LCM CZSC, Martin 2026 and Rombi 2026 chalazal clusters.

MADS TF controlling funiculus development and seed abscission (Pinyopich et al. 2003 Nature; via characterized_markers.tsv). Lowered for this group: also expressed in ovule integuments, Belmonte LCM CZSC, and Picard 2021 chalazal seed coat CxV S3 (ES 3.1) and endosperm VxC E10 (2.7). Funiculus is absent from Picard.
